text: ふむ…　がんばってるな！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something going on now; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. がんばってる = 'you are working hard'.

patterns.name: 〜な (remark)
patterns.explanation: な at the end is a relaxed, mostly male way to share a thought, like 'huh' or 'eh'. がんばってるな = 'you're working hard, eh'.
